stem: A cart used for suspect material is needed next for a clean lot. What should happen?
choices: Complete the required sanitation or segregation step before clean material contacts it
Use it immediately if no residue is visible
Skip sanitation because harvest material is already cut
rationale: Complete the required sanitation or segregation step before clean material contacts it. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
